title: Implement Trie
hints: A trie is a tree whose edges are characters; each node also records whether some inserted word ends there. search and starts_with walk the same path and differ only in what they check at the end.
Each node holds a dict of children and an is_end flag. insert walks the path, creating nodes as needed; a helper that returns the node reached by a string (or None) serves both queries.
search returns node is not None and node.is_end; starts_with returns node is not None. Both are O(len(string)) no matter how many words are stored.
